intro: Lord Maxwell Tyrosus is the supreme commander of the Argent Dawn, stationed at their forward redoubt of Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands. A veteran paladin of the Silver Hand from the Third War, he guides the coalition's crusade against the Scourge and orchestrates strikes into blighted strongholds like Stratholme.

p: Maxwell Tyrosus rode alongside Uther the Lightbringer during the catastrophic Third War, guarding the exits of Andorhal when the Scourge tore through the kingdom. Following the fall of Lordaeron, he joined Highlord Alexandros Mograine in Hearthglen to sustain the resistance against the undead. Even then, Tyrosus advocated for unity across all races, intervening when zealous comrades like Brigitte Abbendis attempted to execute outsiders such as the troll priest Zabra Hexx. When Alexandros was betrayed and the remnants of the Silver Hand degenerated into the fanatical Scarlet Crusade, Tyrosus refused to follow their descent into xenophobia and broke away to help establish the Argent Dawn.

Following the death of Lord Raymond George, Tyrosus assumed leadership of the Argent Dawn. He welcomed Darion Mograine into the fold at Chillwind Point and later oversaw the defensive fortifications of Light's Hope Chapel. During the brutal Siege of the Sanguine, Tyrosus dealt a devastating blow to Kirkessen the Zealous, permanently shattering the lich's corporeal shell. From his command post within the chapel, he oversees broad military operations across the Plaguelands, including tactical assaults led by Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff against Baron Rivendare inside the ruins of Stratholme.
